name: Clipboard tools
description: Remove duplicate or blank clipboard lines and clean whitespace while preserving line breaks.
author: Blockworked

block_defs.description: Removes repeated lines, keeping the first occurrence in order. Matching is exact and case-sensitive; blank lines count as a line. Normalizes CRLF and CR to LF.
Removes empty and whitespace-only clipboard lines, preserving the content of other lines. Normalizes CRLF and CR to LF.
Trims every line, collapses runs of spaces and tabs to one space, and removes blank lines. Keeps line breaks and normalizes CRLF and CR to LF.

blocks.description: Remove duplicate or blank clipboard lines and clean whitespace while preserving line breaks.
